name: PHIP subunit of CUL4-Ring ligase complex
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: PHIP encodes PH-interacting protein. Annotated molecular activities include histone reader activity and insulin receptor binding. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to PHIP-related behavioral problems-intellectual disability-obesity-dysmorphic features syndrome (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
